data.name: Naeeba
data.long_meaning: The name Naeeba is derived from the Arabic word 'naeeb', meaning deputy, trustee, or helper. It is a name rooted in the Islamic tradition, representing the concept of being a faithful servant or representative of Allah. In Quranic contexts, the name is used to describe various aspects of servitude and submission to God.

in_pashto.name: ناعِبَه
